narrative: The tables on the bed. The three lines are in. The red bundle is still apart and knotted. One candle. He reads them and does not add a fourth. No face. The stylus lies in the gutter. No death. No title. No sum under the three lines. The window is black. No face. A thumb on the cover. The three lines still show. The bundle is untouched. No face.
